detail:
Full summary: Triage PR-stage 3a (MCP tool adapter): created src/tools/triage-tools.ts with registerTriageTools registering twining_triage (verbatim §6 description, §4.1 zod shape — all optional, numerics unconstrained, single bare toolResult(TriageResult)); wired into src/server.ts behind options.fullSurface mirroring the verify/export call-site gating; added test/integration/tools/triage-tools.test.ts covering §10.14 tool-side expectations (zod rejects non-numeric window_ms/limit, window_ms:-1 defaults to 7 days via shared buildTriage normalization, registered only when full_surface, no stdout pollution, no HTTP-only initialized decoration). 9/9 new tests, full npm test 1364 passed / 2 pre-existing skips, npm run build clean.
Decisions: Gated twining_triage at the server.ts call site (if (fullSurface) registerTriageTools(...)) rather than an options.fullSurface param inside the register function — mirrors registerVerifyTools/registerExportTools, the existing pattern for modules whose entire surface is fullSurface-gated; decision-tools' per-tool internal gating exists only for mixed-surface modules.; Asserted zod rejection in tests via the SDK's stored inputSchema.safeParse on the registered tool instead of driving an InMemoryTransport client — the SDK's live request path validates with safeParseAsync over the same getZodSchemaObject-wrapped schema, and no existing test in this repo uses a transport client; helpers call handlers directly.; Omitted the TwiningError branch in the twining_triage catch (generic INTERNAL_ERROR only) — buildTriage never throws TwiningError, matching the twining_why handler which also omits the branch.
